svg.title: FIG-12 文档、SDK 与实板验证边界 FIG-12 Documentation, SDK and physical validation boundaries
svg.desc: 精确源码、配置与锁定依赖 Exact source, configuration and locked dependencies; cli.py check / test / build 当前正文、翻译、图与 API cli.py check / test / build Current prose, translations, diagrams and API; 严格双语 HTML 与实际构建报告 只建立文档构建结果 Strict bilingual HTML and actual build report Documentation build scope only; package_source_sdk.py 完整 prefix、依赖与许可证 package_source_sdk.py Complete prefix, dependencies and licenses; verify_consumers.py 独立配置、编译、运行或链接 verify_consumers.py Independent configure, build, execution or linking; 真实 ARM 镜像与配置身份 Actual ARM image and configuration identity; HIL 工装与真实 station PCB、探针、串口与供电 HIL tooling and an actual station PCB, probe, serial and power; 实际刷写与测量才建立物理结果 未接入设备：not_executed Physical results require actual flashing and measurement Equipment unavailable: not_executed; 分别保留原始命令、退出码和报告 无自动部署、候选封存或产品发布 Retain actual commands, exit codes and reports separately No automatic deployment, candidate sealing or product release; 文档输入 Documentation inputs; 实际构建 Actual build; 所选源码闭包 Selected source closure; 完整性核验后的消费 Consume after integrity verification; 实际生成的镜像 Actually linked image; 同一镜像与配置 Same image and configuration; 需要设备实际执行 Requires equipment execution; 文档记录 Documentation record; SDK 消费记录 SDK consumer record; 实板记录 Physical record
